request: My laptop won't turn on at all, it's completely dead, had it about 3.5 years now.
agent_response: Per policy KB-03 (Laptop Replacement), devices are eligible after 3 years of service or verified hardware failure. However, per the Finance & Assets Management Policy (Q2 2026), all hardware follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle. Since your laptop is 3.5 years old, this counts as an early replacement outside the 4-year cycle. Following precedent TK-1043, I have created an active replacement ticket routed for Finance sign-off and IT fulfillment.

request: Can I get Wi-Fi access for a guest visiting our office tomorrow?
agent_response: Per policy KB-07 (Guest Wi-Fi Access), guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated directly by any employee from the front-desk kiosk. No IT support ticket is required. You can print or copy the credentials at the reception desk kiosk tomorrow morning.

request: I'm locked out of my account, tried my password 6 times.

I have queued your account for manual unlock by our service desk team (precedent: TK-1049). No approval required.

request: My VPN stopped working this morning, says credentials expired.

request: Printer on the 3rd floor keeps showing 'paper jam' even though there's no jam.

If the false 'paper jam' error persists on the 3rd floor, please provide the printer's asset tag. A technician is being assigned to inspect the sensor hardware (precedent: TK-1046).
